caption: The drawing shows a rectangular textile design with intricate patterns and bold colors. The main colors used are red, green, and black. The left side features a large paisley motif outlined in green with internal details in red and black, and a central floral shape inside the paisley. The paisley is surrounded by small geometric and botanical shapes. The right side of the rectangle features a combination of abstract and branching vine-like designs in black and green against a red and green background. The central part contains a series of angular, stepped red bands bordered by thin green and black lines, with more leafy or floral motifs filling the spaces between. The background colors transition between shades of red and green, with the patterns alternating in color to create contrast. The entire pattern is set against a plain off-white background.
title: Carpet
